info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API provides a comprehensive view of the current status of real estate listings. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information regarding the listing statuses for properties in the market. Typical consumers include real estate agents, property managers, and prospective buyers who need up-to-date information on property availability and status changes. This API facilitates informed decision-making by delivering precise and timely data on the real estate landscape.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of all listings within the system. It provides an overview of active, pending, and inactive listings, helping you stay up to date with the latest changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of listings. It is expected to conform to the defined schema, ensuring that all necessary information is provided in the proper format.

200.description: The request was successful, and the current status of the listings is returned.
